services.name: Gymnastics Classes for Girls
services.desc: This page lists the various gymnastics classes offered for girls. It does not include the girls competitive team (levels 3-10)** All of our classes start with approximately 8 minutes of warm-ups. Stretching promotes a healthy lifestyle and is occasionally done in the middle or at the end of the workout. Classes sometimes finish with 2 to 3 minutes of fun time in the foam pits, swing, trampolines, rope glide, slide, bounce house, or with the parachute. Most classes usually cover 3 events. Our coaches continually strive to bring fun and excitement to each class by introducing new skills, and practice drills.
